title: Inisfada school for gifted children did remote viewing
place_text: Inisfada, Long Island, New York, USA

tellings.quote: And it was called Inis Fard when he was there. And it was like this weird school for gifted children. And they would do the remote viewing stuff.

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, passes on what a man named Eric Hecker told him about his childhood. According to Anderson, Hecker went to a school called Inisfada on Long Island, New York, a strange school for gifted children where they practised remote viewing, the attempt to see distant places or things using only the mind. If true, it would mean children were being trained in psychic skills.
